description: Record that the signed-in person wants an outside product, usually right after does_it_suit_me. Pass the product page link, a link to its picture, or its description (pass the description too when you have it), and an optional short note. The product is described in the person's own wardrobe terms and saved to their wants, which get_context returns and Alama uses to look for it. Nothing is bought. Works only once the person has turned on 'Allow assistants to change my wardrobe' under Profile → Connected assistants in the Alama app; otherwise it refuses and nothing is saved. Asking twice the same day does not save it twice.
